title: PolicyUpdateProposal
description: The Optimization agent's structured proposal. Validated by steps/optimization_step.py against environment/policy_evidence.py::validate_policy_proposal (hard gate: policy_updates keys must be a subset of ALLOWED_POLICY_KEYS and numeric). On success this is sent, together with the full deterministic evidence dict, as a policy_update_proposal message to the human_oversight mailbox -- the third A2A hop.

policy_updates.description: Keys must be a subset of {queue_size, snapshot_window, slice_capacity} -- the only parameters actually wired to a CLI flag across agents #2-4.
